As of August 4, 2025 nine cases of measles have been confirmed in Wisconsin—one through lab testing and eight based on symptoms and exposure history.
All nine cases are linked to a group that traveled out of state and were exposed to a common source.
DHS reports that no public exposure sites have been identified and the risk to the community remains low.
This is still a critical reminder to make sure you and your family are protected.
At Forward Pharmacy, we’re committed to keeping you informed and protected.
If you have questions about measles or your immunization status, we’re just a call or visit away.
Let’s work together to prevent future outbreaks and keep Wisconsin healthy.
